notes.title: Cinnabunny 1.3 - The Community Events Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! The last few months have flown by once more! Again, I've been working on something on the back-end that I'm very excited to share with everyone, though I'm still not to the point where I'm able to share it. Look for news in the next month or two! Of course, I've also been hard at work adding some fun new content for Cinnabunny! Check out all the changes below:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891363/e56cc1327b6bb53cc6ea5c34679e21c2cdc46f63.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]
Community Events[/h1][p]
Throughout the year, Sugar Creek Burrows will now be celebrating various fun and silly community events. Every season has some unique additions with certain events having mini games or possible rewards.[/p][h3]Aurora View Party[/h3][p]Late at night sometime in the Cold season, the rabbits of Sugar Creek Burrows will gather on the beach to view the beautiful lights in the sky.[/p][p][/p][h3]Biannual Duck Derby[/h3][p]What's a duck derby you ask? It's a rubber ducky race down the river! Twice a year (once in the Windy season and once in the Rainy season), players will be able to select from a list of rubber duckies before the race begins. If your ducky places in the top three, you'll win a small windfall of carrots![/p][p][/p][h3]Lantern Festival[/h3][p]Create your own floating lantern and send it out to sea amidst a flickering ocean of light. This event takes place in the Warm season.[/p][p][/p][h3]Forest Fire Awareness Day[/h3][p]Smokelee the Squirrel takes forest fires very seriously (it is his home, after all!). Join Smokelee in the warm season to practice fighting some (fake) fires around the forest. If you quell enough fires, perhaps you'll win a nice hat![/p][p][/p][h3]Sparkle Night[/h3][p]In the forest one night a year during the Warm season, a whole host of fireflies take to the skies! Explore the woods to enjoy the serenity of their persistent twinkles.[/p][p][/p][h3]Kite Festival[/h3][p]What better way to spend the Windy season than with an array of colorful kites! Join the villagers on the beach and appreciate the kites blowing in the wind, or grab a line yourself and fly it around town![/p][p][/p][h3]Rain Festival[/h3][p]In the Rainy season, the villagers of Sugar Creek Burrows give thanks for the copious amounts of water they receive by having a relaxed and tranquil festival honoring the rain. Listen to some rain drums or tap them yourself for a fun little melody.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Great Bunnish Bakeoff[/h3][p]In the Windy season, join some other baking-oriented villagers to create the tastiest and best looking cake in a new cake-decorating mini-game. If you crack the top three cakes, perhaps you'll win some carrots![/p][p][/p][h1]Other Additions[/h1][p][/p][h3]New furniture item: Calendar[/h3][p]In addition to having a calendar in the Post Office and Tavern, players can also talk to Daisy to get a calendar for their home. Any calendar can be interacted with to display information about community events and bun birthdays.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bun birthdays[/h3][p]Every rabbit in Sugar Creek Burrows now has a birthday! On their birthday, rabbits will wear a party hat and will be more likely to appreciate baked goods as gifts. Keep in mind their taste preferences will still remain! (So if a rabbit doesn't like tart flavors, they will still not enjoy them on their birthday).[/p][p][/p][h3]New baking furniture: Automatic Butter Churn[/h3][p]Available as a hide and squeak reward after constructing the windmill (required to power the churn).[/p][p][/p][h3]New birthday-based dialogue[/h3][p]Added over a hundred lines of new dialogue related to NPCs receiving baked good gifts on a rabbit's birthday.[/p][p][/p][h3]New community event-based dialogue[/h3][p]Added hundreds of new lines of dialogue specific to community events.[/p][p][/p][h3]Added two new hats[/h3][p]Smokelee the Squirrel Hat and the Duck Hat can now be unlocked at their respective community events.[/p][p][/p][h3]QoL improvement: sort inventory[/h3][p]Added a button in the inventory to sort items. In particular, this will make navigating the storage far easier as the player receives more furniture items, baking furniture, wallpapers, and flooring.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891363/9949d143959e4651cd1bd0addaff37509d62e311.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Changed sniff particles to have directional velocity for an easier sense of bun location[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the cost of the cave opening community project (originally 200 carrots, now 150)[/p][/*][*][p]Massive improvements to memory allocation[/p][/*][*][p]Quicker start-up time on game load[/p][/*][*][p]Added splash screen when loading the game[/p][/*][*][p]Edited the town river to be slightly more conducive for the Duck Derby[/p][/*][*][p]Changed maximum and minimum pitch angles for the birdoculars for easier use in specific situations[/p][/*][*][p]Changed landscaping near the waterfall bridge in town for easier player movement[/p][/*][*][p]Some particle and grass optimizations on lower-end hardware[/p][/*][*][p]Made the night sky prettier[/p][/*][*][p]Made bunnies cuter[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891363/635762ae36845142527b4922199c348711a4c3da.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]In rare occasions, NPCs would say dialogue that wouldn't make sense contextually[/p][/*][*][p]Various dialogue typos[/p][/*][*][p]Hide and Squeak grammar fix[/p][/*][*][p]Someone's internet went out when they were donating mushrooms and they missed the steam achievement, so a fix was added to check again whenever mushrooms are sold (instead of just the first time)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed birdocular turn speed being dependent on fps[/p][/*][*][p]Added fail safe in the occasion that NPCs decide to fall through their home floors[/p][/*][*][p]Added cheat code fore resetting NPCs in the main menu if they ever get stuck (enter code: resetnpc)[/p][/*][*][p]In rare circumstances, sometimes NPC relationship status can be reset to zero[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Cinnabunny 1.2 - The Wall Decoration Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! The last two months have flown by! I've been working on something particular on the backend here otherwise this update would have seen the light of day a good bit earlier. I don't want to share exactly what I've been cooking, but I am excited to elucidate you all when the time comes (hopefully soon)! At any rate, I hope you enjoy the second major Cinnabunny update![/p][p][/p][p]   [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891363/e56cc1327b6bb53cc6ea5c34679e21c2cdc46f63.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Decoration Ability[/h2][list][*][p]Players now have the ability to decorate the walls of their bakery![/p][/*][*][p]Plenty of new furniture items have been added which can be placed as wall decorations[/p][/*][*][p]Players can adjust the height and location freely (there is no grid to snap to)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]New Community Upgrade[/h2][h3]Beach Volleyball[/h3][list][*][p] Adds a volleyball net at the town beach [/p][/*][*][p] Requires unlocking kiteboarding first before it will display at the community upgrade board [/p][/*][*][p] Is playable solo or with a friend [/p][/*][*][p] Costs 1000 carrots
 [/p][/*][/list][h2]New Villager Interaction[/h2][list][*][p]Villagers will now have unique dialogue and a unique reward after maxing out their relationship status (i.e., reaching a full three hearts)[/p][/*][*][p]Many new furniture items and hats are only available via max relationship rewards [/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]New Items[/h2][h3]New Wall Decoration Items[/h3][list][*][p]Paintings (simple, naturalistic, stately, nostalgic, watercolor, esoteric, mosaic, diploma) [/p][/*][*][p]Ship wheel[/p][/*][*][p]Wall bird plushie[/p][/*][*][p]Floating bookshelf[/p][/*][*][p]Floating plant shelves[/p][/*][*][p]Floating mushroom shelf[/p][/*][*][p]Wall ivy[/p][/*][*][p]Windows (circular and square)[/p][/*][*][p]First aid kit[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Hats[/h3][list][*][p]Fedora of Capitalism (an end game hat that is purchasable from Freya for one million carrots)[/p][/*][*][p]Bee antennae[/p][/*][*][p]Bunny ears (lol)[/p][/*][*][p]Pancakes[/p][/*][*][p]Slice of Bread[/p][/*][*][p]Carrot Crown [/p][/*][/list][h3]New Furniture Items[/h3][list][*][p]Geode[/p][/*][*][p]Garden Bench[/p][/*][*][p]Garden Table[/p][/*][*][p]Mini Drone Pet[/p][/*][*][p]Antique Mailbox [/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h2]Miscellaneous[/h2][list][*][p]Players now have the ability to toggle the lights in their bakery[/p][/*][*][p]Added more pro bun tips to better guide new players[/p][/*][*][p]New miscellaneous dialogue [/p][/*][/list][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891363/9949d143959e4651cd1bd0addaff37509d62e311.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Miscellaneous dialogue changes[/p][/*][*][p]Miscellaneous material and texture changes[/p][/*][*][p]Further equalized rewards in cave red chests (made certain rare items easier to obtain)[/p][/*][*][p]Altered color of crab particles on the beach[/p][/*][*][p]Changed some bird spawn times to make finding certain birds less rare[/p][/*][*][p]Large database restructures and miscellaneous optimization changes, particularly to improve memory consumption[/p][/*][*][p]Small UI animation additions[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted times that lights turn on around town (shifted more toward twilight instead of 6pm when it was still quite light)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Water Bonnet spawn locations in town[/p][/*][*][p]Baking furniture now has a separate icon to distinguish them from decorations in storage (rolling pin icon)[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now place the mixing bowl counter in storage[/p][/*][*][p]Made bunnies cuter[/p][/*][/list][p]

notes.title: Cinnabunny 1.1.1 hotfix 3
notes.notes: I know it isn't impacting everyone, but intermittent crashes are still impacting a few people and for the sake of those, I shall not stop until it's fixed! I feel hopeful about this one. Fingers crossed I can focus on some other bugs and improvements now! As before, let me know if the game still crashes for anyone and the circumstances if it does.

notes.title: Cinnabunny 1.1.1 hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Okay I did a lot more digging and really fine-tuned the architecture related to level loading / unloading. It's still very difficult to test because I can't reliably reproduce, but hopefully now the crashes people are experiencing coming from the forest are gone! Let me know if that is not the case!

Make sure you verify your game files to ensure you're on the latest patch!

Right click Cinnabunny > properties > installed files > verify integrity of game files

notes.title: Cinnabunny 1.1.1 hotfix 1
notes.notes:
I [i]think [/i]I solved the crashing issue some people were getting after coming back from the forest. I'm not 100% certain since it is very difficult to replicate, only happens sometimes, and doesn't throw any helpful errors.

At any rate, I [i]think [/i]I located the corrupt file and removed it. Please let me know if anyone is still crashing after coming back from the forest!

notes.title: Cinnabunny 1.1 - The Player Booth Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I've been hard at work to address your common suggestions and complaints. I'm hoping Cinnabunny 1.1 gives everyone a little something to be excited for :)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891363/e56cc1327b6bb53cc6ea5c34679e21c2cdc46f63.png[/img]
[h2]Added player stall[/h2]
[list]
[*]The previously empty stall in the marketplace now belongs to you!
[*]The player can decorate their stall with various baked goods and ingredients
[*]The stall can be set open or closed (close the stall if you simply want to make a cute decorative booth, or set it open if you'd like to sell your goods there)
[*]Villagers which pass by might smell the goodness and come purchase something if the stall is open
[*]The player booth provides another avenue for earning same-day carrots, instead of waiting a day by using the shipping box
[/list]
[h2]New Community Upgrades[/h2]
[h3]Gopher Contracting[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds instantaneous travel between selected spots in the town or forest
[*] Four stages to this community upgrade (two for the town, two for the forest)
[*] Requires opening the forest before it is available
[*] Costs 1500, 3000, 4500, 6000 carrots
[/list]
[h3]Bakery Sign[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds a hanging sign above your bakery entrance with your bakery name
[*] Gives the ability to change your bakery name (approach the sign from the roof)
[*] Requires opening the caves first before appearing
[*] Costs 250 carrots
[/list]
[h3]Marketplace Clipboards [/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds clipboards to Juniper and Chip's stalls which allows for making item requests
[*] The amount of items you can request depends on relationship status with the vendor (i.e. you need one heart to request one item, two hearts to request two items, etc.)
[*] Costs 25 carrots
[/list]
[h3]Bakery Size Increase 4 & 5[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each new bakery size increase adds a separate room, one to the right, and one at the back
[*] Can set the wallpaper and flooring of these rooms to be distinct from each other and the main room/loft
[*] Costs 12,500 and 20,000 carrots, respectively
[/list]
[h3]More Forest Bridges[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds five new bridges in the forest to make crossing the river easier
[*] Requires opening the forest first
[*] costs 750 carrots
[/list]

[h2]New Forest Activity: Hide and Squeak[/h2]
[list]
[*] If the conditions are right, a squirrel friend will spawn in the forest near the handcart
[*] Talking to the squirrel will start a small mini game of hide and squeak
[*] Track down the squirrel and catch them a few times to win important prizes
[*] Requires forest bridges to be built before they will show up
[*] Squirrels will only spawn if they have a new and unique valid prize to give you
[/list]

[h2]New Items[/h2]
[h3]New Baking Furniture: Automatic Sugar Grinder & Automatic Milk Press[/h3]
[list]
[*] Squirrel hide and squeak rewards
[*] Requires constructing a windmill first
[/list]
[h3]New Hats: Butterfly Hat and Butterfly Wings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Squirrel hide and squeak rewards
[*] Requires moving in family members before squirrels will give as reward
[/list]
[h3]New Tool: Lantern[/h3]
[list]
[*] Allows you to light up the world around you (most notably effective in town and forest at night)
[*] New quest associated with acquiring this tool
[*] Look for strange little fireflies in the town and forest after twilight to initiate the quest
[/list]
[h3]New Furniture Items: Instruments (Guitar, Violin, and Drum Kit)[/h3]
[list]
[*] After placing these items in the bakery, the player can interact with them to play pretty music in the same key as the background music
[*] Squirrel hide and squeak rewards
[*] Requires moving in family members before squirrels will give as reward
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added five new mouth patterns more consistent with actual rabbit mouth anatomy
[*] Walking next to player planted trees and shrubs will now yield important information (days until maturity, days until production, seasons of production, etc)
[*] Added text to the HUD when using the seed bag to display the name of the currently selected seed
[*] Added poop mode (enter code "poop" in settings in the main menu)
[*] Bun Run now has a high score tracker which saves per machine
[*] Added option in settings for changing foliage density independent of general scalability settings
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891363/9949d143959e4651cd1bd0addaff37509d62e311.png[/img]


[list]
[*] Destroying a fruit tree with the scythe now yields a sapling of the same type (helpful when accidentally planting in the wrong spots)
[*] Player no longer needs to babysit Juniper to ensure she plants things in the community garden (though she will plant slightly more if you are nearby... she's an extrovert so)
[*] Sage can now possibly sell one extra mixing bowl counter and one extra rolling pin counter if playing in co-hop
[*] Photograph a bird errands on the request board now guarantee that bird will spawn somewhere in the town or forest, ignoring season, weather, and time requirements
[*] Capture a recyclobot errands on the request board now guarantee that recyclobot will spawn somewhere in the town or forest
[*] Changed the text when exiting the game if the player hasn't saved within the past hour
[*] Re-organized gameplay settings into distinct sections for better readability
[*] Changed the color of the green glowing cave grass to make it more visually distinct from the blue version
[*] Reconfigured bird spawns to more evenly distribute what birds will appear in the town and forest (weather, time of day, and seasonal spawn requirements still must be met)
[*] Reworded some capture quest text on the request boards to be less misleading
[*] Slight changes to NPC behavior when roaming to make the community feel more alive
[*] Reduced rate of mushrooming skill level up by 12.5%
[*] Increased rate of easter egging skill level up by 33%
[*] Bald patch of grass above player bakery plus minor terrain tweaks
[*] Oat -> Milk conversion is now 3 to 1 instead of 4 to 1
[*] Reduced milk value from 12 to 9 carrots
[*] Reduced butter value from 24 to 18 carrots
[*] When receiving carrots for errands or from other sources, the carrots now visually gravitate toward the player instead of falling to the ground
[*] Refined NPC collisions amongst themselves
[*] Miscellaneous optimizations
[*] Made bunnies cuter
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891363/635762ae36845142527b4922199c348711a4c3da.png[/img]


[list]
[*] Anita's roof moving when it's windy
[*] Technically possible to fail the baking tutorial by performing a very specific sequence of events
[*] Hopping off the deer in the caves when the flutterby brings you back causes the deer to spawn at the cave entrance, but not the player
[*] Player 2 unable to remove planted trees
[*] Please, NPCs stop scuba diving I'm begging you
[*] Sometimes flour doesn't show its value correctly in the shipping bin
[*] Certain inventory items causing save file and memory bloat after playing for a long time
[*] Default camera pitch setting not saving after using the handcart
[*] Using the flutterby to exit the forest in co-hop while the other player is on a deer causes... issues
[*] In co-hop, a second player interacting with bun run while another player is already doing so creates a soft lock
[*] Request board errands disappear under specific circumstances when using a mouse and keyboard
[*] Small hole at the top of the flour mill's gear
[*] Recyclobots unintentionally faster on slopes
[/list]

notes.title: Cinnabunny Official Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h2]The Cinnabunny Closed Beta[/h2]

The Cinnabunny beta is going extremely well. Of my many wonderful beta testers, I've had about five people take it directly upon themselves to break the game at all costs. You may be thinking, aw that's mean, but nay! It is actually the most incredibly helpful thing in the world! These testers would be payed top dollar at a quality assurance company.

Their helpfulness and diligence has greatly assisted me in finding lots of niche bugs (and some admittedly not niche ones) and we've been a great team to get Cinnabunny in a very stable state. I'm sure there will be some more things to iron out in the next couple of months, but over the past 13 days since the beta's release, I've put out five patches with tons of additions, gameplay tweaks, and bug fixes, due in large part to their reports.

[h1]Release Date Announcement[/h1]

I've taken stock of where I am with the game, and what still needs to be accomplished before release. And, well, I'm going to do something no Kickstarter developer has ever done before. I'm going to release... early! DUH DUH DUH!!!

When the Kickstarter for Cinnabunny launched, I told my backers that I was planning for a mid-March release. Well, I'm beyond excited to share the official Steam release date...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891363/b26a07ff3bb0a328cb8c66ba48d77b99083f9c91.png[/img]

That's right! [b]Cinnabunny will be launching at 1pm EST on February 19th, 2025[/b]. That's less than two months away! Now, I'm sure some of you might be thinking, "well, hold on there, cowboy. What's the deal? You trying to rush the release or something?" Nope! It's really quite straightforward: the game is in a good state, I have dedicated beta testers that are helping me iron out all the nasty bugs, and the game is simply going to be ready earlier than I thought. Cinnabunny is a game three years in the making, two of those full time. I've worked very hard and I stand by the games I put out; Cinnabunny is ready for the world!

Additionally, I'm not going to abandon the game after release. I'm not sure I explicitly stated this anywhere yet, but I do plan to continually update Cinnabunny with new features and content (and bug fixes, of course) just like I did with my previous game Bunhouse. You have my word that [b]any future content for Cinnabunny after release will be completely free; there will never be in game purchases or paid DLC.[/b]

Thank you all for your support! And please share the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2794830/Cinnabunny/]Cinnabunny steam page[/url] with anyone who you think might enjoy it!
